basic_details.job_title: Uttarakhand High Court Law Researcher Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Uttarakhand High Court has released an official notification for the recruitment of Law Researcher Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official Uttarakhand High Court website. The last date to submit the application form is 03-08-2026. In this article, you'll find the Law Researcher recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and application form.

age_limit.details: Not more than 30 years of age as on the date of making the application. Relaxation may be granted by the Chief Justice.

qualification.details: Graduate in law from a duly recognized law school/college/university/institute established by law in India and eligible for enrolment as an Advocate with the Bar Council of India. Final year students pursuing three/five year degree in law will also be eligible to apply subject to furnishing proof of acquiring the law qualification at the time of interview/before taking up the engagement as LR. Good working knowledge of computers.

selection_process: Selection shall be made on the basis of assessment as prescribed by the Hon'ble Judge concerned. Only shortlisted candidates shall be called for said assessment as per the Scheme. The Hon'ble Judge may
decide whether or not to call any applicant for interview. LRs shall be finally selected by the Hon'ble Judge to whom the LR is to be attached.
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Uttarakhand High Court Law Researcher Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 03-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Uttarakhand High Court to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Law Researcher post in Uttarakhand High Court?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Law Researcher position in the Uttarakhand High Court is 03 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Law Researcher role?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a graduate in law from a recognized institution and eligible for enrolment as an Advocate with the Bar Council of India. Final year students are also eligible.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 30 years as of the application date. Age relaxation may be granted by the Chief Justice.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Law Researcher position?
faq.answer: The selected Law Researcher will receive a fixed monthly honorarium of ₹50,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Law Researcher recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply online through the prescribed Google Form available on the official website of the Uttarakhand High Court.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Law Researcher post?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on an assessment prescribed by the concerned Hon'ble Judge. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the assessment.

faq.question: Q8. Can final year law students apply for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, final year students pursuing a three or five-year law degree are eligible, provided they can furnish proof of acquiring the qualification at the time of the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies for the Law Researcher post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Law Researcher post in the Uttarakhand High Court.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application link?
faq.answer: The official notification and application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article.
